description: Trust-sanitization matrix cell: financial_hash_only, strict_trust=true, verify_evidence=true. Hash evidence establishes content-integrity (hash_verified) but MUST NOT upgrade provenance to trusted under v0.8.3 semantics; the causal-contract check sees untrusted provenance and blocks with PIC_VERIFIER_FAILED. If a future refactor puts hash IDs into trust_upgrade_ids, this cell flips to allow and points at the regression.
source: Renamed from conformance/trust_sanitization/financial_hash_ok__strict-t__verify-t.json in v0.8.3 to disambiguate the hash-only anti-example from the signed ALLOW example. Updated per issue #133.
